findings.description: Guard.close precedes the final lease/input check. publish_terminal checks only time while hashing and publishing. Late parent cancellation or a pinned input change is never checked again, so complete outcomes survive authority loss.
findings.expected: Keep authority and frozen inputs verified through normal publication; cancellation or identity loss must produce failure exit 1 and invalidate complete terminal status.
findings.recommended_direction: Maintain lease checks and bounded input verification through hashing/publication without reopening manifest-bound streams; revalidate before success becomes authoritative. Preserve deadline and positive writer-absence checks.
findings.reproduction: From repository root, set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and TMPDIR to this review directory/tmp. Run learning/.venv/bin/python -B learning/runs/v2/postovernight-long-D2-supervisor-review-r1/probes.py late-lease-cancel-fresh-real-guard. The suffix must name an unused owned scenario directory; the script refuses overwrite.
findings.title: Lease and frozen-input verification stop before normal terminal publication

findings.description: The supervisor cancellation context has ended, and publish_terminal restores prior handlers before the enclosing alarm context exits. SIGTERM is SIG_DFL at that boundary, so default termination bypasses BaseException revocation.
findings.expected: Latch SIGTERM through outer-context restoration and ensure no cancelled completion receipt survives.
findings.impact_boundary: A compliant parent checking raw process exit rejects -15. This does not demonstrate parent acceptance of a cancelled run; it demonstrates missing required signal latching and stale authoritative complete artifacts.
findings.recommended_direction: Keep one outer cancellation envelope across normal publication, alarm-context exit, and final status decisions; revoke completion when the latch is set.
findings.reproduction: Use the same isolated environment as SUP-001 and run probes.py outer-alarm-fresh-SIGTERM with an unused scenario directory. This intentionally SIGTERMs only its own synthetic supervisor process after the owned worker is reaped.
findings.title: Outer publication-context SIGTERM is not latched and leaves complete authoritative artifacts

limitations: No actual Torch/native/MPS integration, entry restore/determinism, model inference, PPO, throughput or qualification proof.
Synthetic probes inject authority/clock/IO boundary events; they are not a real experiment.
A compliant parent must inspect raw exit and actual wall time in addition to terminal artifact bindings.
